waves.scope: every pool man whose 2025-2026 club is Liverpool, his 2024-2025 row, the Liverpool men whose careers ended, the calendar club men held for a relabel round, and the Alisson twin

policy: A tuple quarantined on 2026-09-07 never returns as it was. A new row for the same player, season and club is written only from new research recorded here, with club, goals and appearances each carried by two independent non-wiki hosts. Assists are null (shown n/a) unless two sources agree on them, and market value is 0 (shown n/a) unless two sources agree on it (the Round 784 convention). A 2024-2025 row found to be a mid-season snapshot is corrected through changed, field by field, each new value two-sourced and each old value guarded in the migration.

convention.split: A new spell at a European or Saudi club is written 2025-2026.
convention.calendar: A new spell at a calendar league club (MLS, Brazil, Argentina, Japan) is written as the calendar year 2025, after the precedent of Giroud 2025 LAFC.
convention.never: Nothing is written 2026. Only a plain hyphen joins the years.
convention.held: A man whose legacy rows at a calendar league club are split style gets no new row until a relabel round decides what those rows mean; he is listed under held.
convention.stats: Appearances and goals are all competitions club totals for the season (league, domestic cups, Europe and the super cup), the convention the bake's completed seasons follow. National team games are never counted.
convention.midSeason: A mid-season move is two rows with the same season string, appended in date order.

sources.lfchistory: lfchistory.net season archive pages: appearances, goalscorers and assists per season with League, FA Cup, League Cup, Europe and Other columns (season 134 is 2024-2025, 135 is 2025-2026), read 2026-10-05
sources.footballdatabase: footballdatabase.eu player details pages, the per season competition rows for the club summed (national team rows excluded), read 2026-10-05
sources.soccerbase: soccerbase.com player match logs per season (season_id 157 is 2024/2025, 158 is 2025/2026), club games counted (national team games excluded), read 2026-10-05
sources.liverpoolfc: liverpoolfc.com, the club's own news pages

removed.reason: The same man twice: both entries carry the same 13 season and club keys (Round 667 and Round 784 recorded it). The entry people type and the verified active identity is Alisson, so Alisson Becker goes and his 13 puzzles are renamed to Alisson.
